title: Placement 评分
implementation: Decision() is a pure function over an immutable candidate snapshot and performs no network, database, or state mutation
Hard filters require placeable/AVAILABLE health, VERIFIED profile, VERIFIED storage, TRUSTED capacity, sufficient effective free bytes, and available inflight capacity
INSTANCE_GROUP candidates use instance weight, normalized free ratio, inflight penalty, current download load penalty, and recent Add latency penalty
FIXED_INSTANCE filters all other candidates and never silently falls back to another qB
Decision output contains AlgorithmVersion, ranked candidates, selected target, full score breakdown, rejection reasons, and stable SHA-256 tie-break
Prioritize() places official items ahead of non-official work while keeping discovery order and identity tie-break deterministic
Decision inputs are caller-supplied snapshots; no long-term upload prediction or fake qB performance evidence is inferred
